failed_conditions.quote: A second potential problem is that stereo_image_proc is not running at frame rate. You can see that stereo_view is getting less than one disparity image for every five image pairs.
failed_conditions.reason: The documented disparity/image rate imbalance implicates all three input streams and fits rate_shortfall. The answer calls the queue-exhaustion explanation a potential problem; the displayed message counts establish the imbalance, not an independently proven causal decomposition.

failed_conditions.quote: If you're running two prosilica_camera instances, probably they are not synchronized - that is, left and right image time stamps don't match up exactly. All the image_pipeline nodes assume exact synchronization for stereo (the ideal case) by default.
failed_conditions.reason: Exact versus approximate timestamp matching has no dedicated class in S1, so other is appropriate. Both message headers and the three synchronized topics participate. The answer explicitly qualifies the camera-timestamp diagnosis as probable, not directly measured.
